projects.title: Project One
projects.short: Design-forward marketing site to increase trial signups.

content.overview: Project One is a single-page marketing site with animated hero, fast load times, and accessible forms.
content.challenge: Visitors were leaving before reaching signup due to slow images and unclear copy.
content.solution: Progressive image placeholders, simplified copy, and clear CTAs.
content.outcome: Improved trial conversions and Core Web Vitals scores.

content.overview: A real-time analytics dashboard with streaming updates and client-side optimizations.
content.challenge: Present complex data clearly while maintaining performance.
content.solution: Virtualization, payload minimization, and progressive enhancement.
content.outcome: Lowered client CPU usage and faster time-to-interactive.

projects.title: Project Three
projects.short: Composable design system used across multiple products.

content.overview: A shared component library with accessibility patterns and CI checks.
content.challenge: Maintain consistency and accessibility across product teams.
content.solution: Semantic components, keyboard support, and documentation.
content.outcome: Faster feature delivery and improved UI consistency.
